ways.label: East to west: Greyneys Shelter to Morrisons footbridge

start.name: Greyneys Shelter car park on SH73

end.name: Morrisons footbridge on SH73, near Aickens corner

evidence: From the eastern side, the route starts near Greyneys Shelter on SH73. It follows the Mingha River, crosses the Main Divide at Goat Pass, then follows the Deception River to come out at Morrisons footbridge on SH73, near Aickens corner.
From the car park at Greyneys Shelter, cross the road and go through the underpass below the railway tracks.
The footbridge across the Otira is just north of the confluence (on the true right bank of the Deception).

ways.label: West to east: Morrisons footbridge to Greyneys Shelter

start.name: Morrisons footbridge on SH73, near Aickens corner

evidence: From the western side, the route starts at Morrisons footbridge on SH73, near Aickens corner. It follows the Deception River, crosses the Main Divide at Goat Pass, then follows the Mingha River to come out at SH73 by Greyneys Shelter.
After 500 m, go through the underpass below the railway tracks and cross the road to Greyneys Shelter.

doubts: The page describes the same route in both directions (east to west first, then west to east), each with its own section; I recorded east to west as the main way and the reverse as W2. Direction is given only as east/west, so direction is null. Start F4 (Mingha Track meets West Coast Road) is taken as Greyneys Shelter on SH73 because the route begins up the Mingha; the text does not name the Mingha Track. End F2 (Deception Valley Route meets Morrison Footbridge) is taken for Morrisons footbridge; F1 (an unnamed track at Otira Highway) is nearby and could be the road side of the bridge. Per-way times are given only by leg (5 hr and 8-9 hr), so DOC's overall 2 - 3 days is used. Lake Mavis and Bealey River have no entries.
